$comment: SYNTHETIC. Repositories are PLACEHOLDERS — no agent is bound to these.
Everything the policy can grant is granted, and two repositories are bound.
That is the isolation the bound rows need. With a narrower fixture a refusal
would be ambiguous — the bound could have held, or the policy could have
refused first — and the bypass would look contained. Here the repository
argument is the only thing left that can decide, so an OutOfBounds verdict
proves the bound holds and an Allowed verdict proves it was walked past.
